wiki_install_artifact.release_target: master (branch name, not a commit SHA)

verified_facts.wiki_stale_vs_master: wiki says pass --exporter.fhir.use_us_core_ig true to get US Core; master default is already true => defaults are version-dependent
verified_facts.determinism_statement: wiki: same seed + same version => identical. INCOMPLETE: age depends on reference date (-r) and provider selection on clinician seed (-cs); config also matters
verified_facts.provider_data: default providers are REAL US facilities post-processed from CMS public data incl. name, address, PHONE, emergency flag; quality score 'does nothing'; non-US requires custom demographics/zip/provider files (wiki UK example)

classification.SYNTHETIC_vs_CLINICALLY_VALID: Synthea output is synthetic; NOT clinically validated. Names carry numeric suffixes by default (config-dependent marker, not a guarantee)

classification.BALI_CLAIM: A Bali fixture 'generated from Synthea' needs custom demographics/zip/provider inputs (US-default); those inputs need their own provenance+rights. Else it is hand-authored, not Synthea output
classification.FHIR_TRANSFORM: NOT_TESTED (LOADS/TRANSFORMS/ROUNDTRIP/SEMANTIC all NOT_TESTED); expect transaction Bundles with urn:uuid refs + separate hospital/practitioner info files
